## Checklist

- [ ] The change belongs in this repository and follows its contribution instructions.
- [ ] The description explains the result and the relevant validation performed.
- [ ] Code examples, commands, and documentation match the delivered behavior.
- [ ] If assets changed, their origin and permission status are documented and relevant previews/catalog updates are included.
- [ ] The diff, logs, and previews contain no secrets, personal data, confidential material, or accidental system files.
